notes: «محمد بن الحسن» and «محمد بن الحسن الصفار» are two men, each with its own «حدثني» (rule 7 counter-example), so two links.
«عَنْ أَخِیهِ الْحَسَنِ» is one link with surface «الحسن» (rule 7).
The Imam is named after «قال قال» only in the words; he is the last link (owner ruling 2). The «ع» blessing is not part of the surface.
